install: claude mcp add sonarqube --env SONARQUBE_TOKEN=$SONARQUBE_TOKEN --env SONARQUBE_ORG=$SONARQUBE_ORG --env SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY=true -- docker run -i --rm --init --pull=always -e SONARQUBE_TOKEN -e SONARQUBE_ORG -e SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY sonarsource/sonarqube-mcp
verify: Ask Claude Code to find a SonarQube project by name and show its quality gate status.
read_only_mitigation: Set SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY=true (disables write operations) and use a user with browse permission only. Source: https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-mcp-server/reference/environment-variables.md
